opening.argument: The speaker actively presents Forsage as a route to earning Ethereum, while tying payment to recruitment and investment by others. He states that “I get paid when somebody joins my team” through an affiliate link and explains that another participant must join his team and invest for him to earn. The process also requires viewers to set up a wallet, purchase Ethereum, join a contract, and visit an external website while discussing how to start making money. This is not merely a personal account: the video supplies a recruitment funnel and affiliate-link instructions, including a free funnel for team members. The exact destination, contract terms, payouts, losses, and independent verification remain unestablished, but the observable structure is a tiered recruitment commission scheme.
